hymns.text: A prorocului Tău Iezechiel pomenire, Doamne, prăznuind, printr-însul Te rugăm, mântuieşte sufletele noastre.

english.text: Keeping the memory of Your prophet Ezekiel, O Lord, through him we entreat You: save our souls.
